summary_40_60: Jack Jin is an Associate Director at Accenture in Columbus, Ohio, an Adobe Certified Master and an AEM Champion 2026. He builds AI agent systems and writes about Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Edge Delivery Services (EDS) and agentic engineering. This site holds his posts, videos, projects, talks and certifications.
